title: Grievance & Casus Belli Intake Form
subtitle: “Omnis Questus, Nullus Sanguis” — All Profit, No Blood

style.head: split
style.motto: PROFIT ABOVE ALL · NEUTRAL BY POLICY ·

instructions: **Before you begin:** this form must be completed in full before any declaration of hostilities against the Consolidated Industrial Concern will be acknowledged, reviewed, tabled, or otherwise considered to exist. Incomplete submissions are not rejected — they are simply filed alongside complete ones, in the same drawer, in no particular order.

sections.title: Nature of Correspondence

fields.text: **Matter:** declaration of hostilities against the Consolidated Industrial Concern. **Status:** received. Filed under *Correspondence*. Not read.

fields.name: correspondence_type
fields.label: Your correspondence with the Concern is best described as (select all that apply):
options: A formal declaration of war
A warning
An ultimatum
A demand for reparations
A threat of an unspecified kind
A request for a meeting, phrased aggressively
None of the above; this is a social call

sections.note: Where more than one box is selected, each is treated as a separate declaration and requires its own Form GC-1.

fields.name: party_name
fields.label: Name of declaring party / organization
fields.placeholder: As it will appear in Ledger 7

fields.name: other_names
fields.label: Any other names, tags, or spellings under which the declaring party has operated
fields.help: Each name listed is registered as a separate entity and must file its own Form GC-1.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Preferred correspondence channel
fields.placeholder: Frequency, relay, or carrier pigeon designation

fields.name: not_at_war
fields.label: I attest that I am not currently at war with the CIC as of the date of this filing.
fields.help: If checked in error, see Form GC-1b, “Retroactive Peace.”

sections.title: Casus Belli Classification

fields.name: casus_belli
fields.label: Grounds on which hostilities are declared (select all that apply)
options: Grid or cargo theft
Territorial dispute
Commercial dispute (price, delivery, or refusal to sell)
Aesthetic grievance (paint scheme, ship silhouette, or station lighting)
Conduct attributed to a member of the Concern
The Concern’s refusal to take sides
Vibes
Unspecified / classified — grounds to be disclosed only to a notary who is currently on sabbatical
Other — attach Form GC-4, “Explain Yourself”

sections.note: Selecting every box is treated as selecting none, per Subsection 12(c)(iv)(iv). Selecting none is not permitted.

sections.title: Statement of Grievance

fields.name: statement
fields.label: Describe the grievance in no fewer than 500 words. Testimony is preferred in the third person.
fields.placeholder: Begin with: “On the date in question, the aggrieved party…”

fields.name: grievance_date
fields.label: Date on which the grievance arose

fields.name: named_individual
fields.label: Name of any individual whose conduct is complained of

sections.note: Statements under 500 words will not be rejected, but will be quietly assumed to be Section 5 material and re-filed accordingly.

fields.name: asset
fields.label: Designation of any asset the declaring party claims to have lost or had damaged
fields.placeholder: Ship, station, or grid name, with registry number

fields.name: loss_value
fields.label: Estimated value of losses, in credits

fields.name: settlement
fields.label: Sum that would settle the matter, in credits

fields.name: no_coordinates
fields.label: I confirm that no coordinates have been written on this form.
fields.help: The Concern knows where every faction is and discloses none of them. It asks the same courtesy of you.

fields.name: attachments
fields.label: Attachments enclosed with this form (select all that apply)
options: Proof of Standing (Form GC-2)
Certificate of Grievance Severity (Form GC-3, which itself requires Form GC-3a)
Notarized copy of this form, in triplicate, notarized by someone other than the notary listed in Section 7
Declaration of Non-Duplicative Grievance, swearing this filing is not a duplicate of any Form GC-1 already on file, including this one
Statement of Intended Outcome (Form GC-5)

fields.name: notary
fields.label: Notary public signature
fields.placeholder: Currently on sabbatical — see Form GC-9 to request alternate notarization

fields.name: correspondence_ack
fields.label: I acknowledge that completing this form constitutes correspondence with the Concern, and that correspondence may generate further forms.

finePrint: By filing, the declaring party acknowledges that this form does not constitute acceptance, rejection, or acknowledgment of any grievance, hostility, or correspondence, and may generate further forms.
transmittal: **Transmittal:** send this copy to the Consolidated Industrial Concern by the channel through which your declaration was made. Retain a duplicate. The Concern will retain the original, and will not read it.

receipt.message: Your copy of **{{code}}** has been saved as **{{file}}**. Send it to the Concern. Before this matter can proceed, please complete **Form {{next}}** (attached).
footnotes: Note: Form {{next}} supersedes Form {{code}} but does not invalidate it. Both remain on file, indefinitely, in the same drawer.
